backgrounds.description: [Background placeholder] Mountain campsite, dying campfire embers, tent silhouettes. The night before the teacher vanished.
[Background placeholder] 90s RV interior, narrow aisle, wasteland highway out the window.
[Background placeholder] Empty freeway, rusted signs, city skyline in the distance.
[Background placeholder] City streets after all the adults vanished—still cars, scattered debris.
[Background placeholder] ER lobby, flickering cold white lights, half-empty medicine shelves.
[Background placeholder] Corner pharmacy, shattered window—antibiotics are the prize here.
[Background placeholder] Abandoned gas station, pumps dead—gas decides whether you keep moving.
[Background placeholder] At the end of a distant light beam—a tall transmission tower, nothing on top.
[Background placeholder] Radio tower roof, campfire under the stars, teens talking late into the night.
[Background placeholder] Cramped city rental—the normal ending's landing in the real world.
[Background placeholder] Ten years later, black suits, stone marker—the bad ending's real world.
[Background placeholder] Hidden ending—characters break the fourth wall and leave the set.
[Background placeholder] True ending meta curtain call—characters in everyday clothes, standing in light.
